verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents connecting HubSpot, Salesforce and Stripe so Ari plans from those records, and forecasting revenue from business drivers. It also imports actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite or Rillet into a live model rebuilt overnight off the close, and Ari messages you when something moves. Missing for 10: an explicit plan-vs-actual or variance view, detail on how pipeline stages or subscription metrics (e.g. MRR or churn) drive the revenue plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
